proposal: The Mandate recommends working with Congress to sunset VA's Office of Accountability and Whistleblower Protection, on the ground that its work duplicates supervisors, equal employment opportunity offices, the Inspector General, the Office of Special Counsel and other accountability programs.

status_summary: No bill, rule or order sunsetting the Office of Accountability and Whistleblower Protection was found. The office is established in statute at 38 U.S.C. 323, added by Public Law 115-41 in 2017, with no later amendments shown, and a VA whistleblower page last updated 2025-02-04 still lists it as a channel for disclosures.
title: Sunset the Office of Accountability and Whistleblower Protection
uncertainties: The VA rule list on reginfo.gov (labeled Agency Rule List - 2026, 62 rules) lists no rulemaking on OAWP; RIN 2900-AS80 concerns cemetery grant accountability and is not the recommended action. The statute was read on the Cornell Legal Information Institute copy because the House Law Revision Counsel page returned a not-found page. H.R. 472 (Restore VA Accountability Act of 2025) changes removal procedures and its summary does not mention OAWP; its full text was not read. A 2022 House discussion draft predates the period.
